name: payments-dashboard
description: Full-stack payments dashboard — NestJS API + React/TS SPA, one Railway service.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @pay/contracts && npm run build -w @pay/api && npm run build -w @pay/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c gray,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @pay/contracts" "npm run dev -w @pay/api" "npm run dev -w @pay/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @pay/api && npm run test -w @pay/web
